description: Explain a 5-field cron expression and list the next scheduled runs, identical to the Toolars cron-builder-explainer web tool. Runs entirely locally; no network or filesystem access. Input and result enter the MCP client context and may be sent to its model provider.

count.description: How many upcoming runs to list (at most 25).

timeZone.description: One of UTC, local, America/New_York, Europe/London, Europe/Berlin, Asia/Shanghai, Asia/Tokyo, Asia/Seoul, Asia/Kolkata, Australia/Sydney.

name: toolars_cron_explain
